# The note bases step 11 relocates, and therefore the ones whose bytes are
# recorded before it runs. Directory names only -- never note titles, which is
# why this file can be committed to a public repository and the manifest it
# produces cannot. See bin/migrate-golden-corpus.
#
# Each line is a path relative to $OBSIDIAN_VAULT, and every one of them must
# exist: a base that has stopped being a directory is the failure this is
# looking for, not a line to skip. Three of these hold no notes today
# (Companies, Tool Stack, space) and are listed anyway, because a move
# relocates an empty directory too and its disappearance should be loud.
#
# Two pairs read as duplicates and are not. `Learning` and
# `System/Databases/Learning` are different directories holding different
# notes, and the second is the one with Books/, Courses/ and YouTube/ beneath
# it. The scan is recursive, so those subdirectories need no line of their own.
